current_goal: Freeze the remaining MD-2S bulk, localized and parameter functions, define angular and global flux conventions, then construct the symbolic dependency map required before any official boundary-value solver work.

verified_results.statement: The current canonical rebuild separates the geometric cosmological constant Lambda_geom in the Einstein-Hilbert sector from the scalar energy density U(phi), preventing silent vacuum-energy double counting.
With outward normals on both regions, the two independent metric junction equations require Y_sigma=(L_Sigma-A_Sigma)/kappa6_squared and lambda=(7 A_Sigma+L_Sigma)/(2 kappa6_squared).
The scalar junction retains the regional Z_phi factors and the local gauge equation is separate from global flux quantization.

For the current HZT-M0-S6 Einstein-Maxwell-scalar action skeleton, the static axial metric yields explicit external, radial and internal Einstein equations, a Maxwell first integral, a scalar equation and a radial Hamiltonian constraint.

The generic smooth-center expansion fixes the leading coefficients once the local action functions, flux constant and angular period are supplied; a nonzero deficit angle identifies the conical center mode.
For the minimal HZT-M0-S6 Einstein-Hilbert sector, the bulk four-dimensional normalization is M4_bulk_squared=V_W/kappa6_squared with V_W equal to the warped internal two-volume.
The archived value V_W=0.5318111250097 cannot determine kappa4 because its angle factor, dimensional normalization and four-dimensional frame convention remain unresolved.

open_blockers.statement: The exact functional forms and parameter domains of U(phi), Z_phi(phi), Z_F(phi), lambda(phi) and Z_sigma(phi) remain unfrozen.
The angular period, winding and gauge-patch convention, q_sigma normalization and global flux quantization remain open.
The complete second-region geometry, numerical one-sided boundary data and normalized junction tolerances are absent, so the two-junction verdict remains non-executable.
The numerical warped volume requires reproduced A(r), L(r), the angular period or deficit convention, a fixed four-dimensional frame and convergence-tested integration.

active_assumptions: The controlled reduction branch is HZT-M0-S6 with one physical time and a positive-definite internal two-space.
Lambda_geom and U(phi) are distinct current-canon symbols until historical model identity is proven.
Each region uses its own outward spacelike normal in the Israel sum.

Official solver work remains forbidden until all MF-001 through MF-007 requirements are source-backed and collision-free.
